conditions: Matched-conditions: Boltz2-predicted BDBV-43 Fab + full-length LGALS3BP (585 aa), unglycosylated protein; CDR-H3-only redesign.

contact_definitions.note: heavy-atom PDBs, no explicit H; hbond = N/O pair <3.5A proxy

glycan_aware.glycan_model: Representative N-glycan, simplified 12-sugar linear model at Asn362 (C-terminal flank of BACK domain 260-360)
glycan_aware.e1_epitope_definition: BACK-domain (260-360) antigen solvent surface (approximation; paper's exact E1 mapping unavailable)
glycan_aware.area_difference_convention: dSASA = SASA_BACK(unglycosylated) - SASA_BACK(with glycan); positive = glycan occludes
glycan_aware.note: Study's exact E1 mapping and glycan model unavailable (paper inaccessible). Matched-conditions approximation using verified UniProt BACK domain (260-360) and N-glycosylation site (362).

glycan_global.description: Global glycan-associated SASA reduction over the full-length LGALS3BP antigen (matched-conditions analog of the paper's ~1,299 A^2).
glycan_global.status: NOT REPRODUCIBLE with simplified glycan model
glycan_global.reason: Simplified glycan atoms (5-17 A from Asn side-chain attachment) are farther from the antigen than the rolling-probe centers (3.1 A from atom), so no probe points are occluded. A realistic multi-conformation N-glycan ensemble (as used in the paper) is required.
glycan_global.sasa_bug_note: The original custom probe-based SASA (06_glycan_aware.py) overestimates SASA ~5-10x: its occlusion test uses d < r_j instead of d < (r_probe + r_j), under-counting burial. BiOTITE 1.4.0 is the authoritative cross-check.
glycan_global.benchmark_reference: Paper reports ~1,299 A^2 for its mature construct with a conformational-diversity N-glycan ensemble.
glycan_global.comparability: NOT REPRODUCIBLE. The published ~1,299 A^2 requires the study's multi-conformation glycan ensemble and mature construct, neither of which is available.

benchmark_note: Published 161/165/67%/5A/2.9A2 require the study's mature construct, glycan model, E1 mapping and heated-MD replicas (paper inaccessible). Matched-conditions comparison only.
